answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. By the zephyr of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, reduced by each unverified claim, rewards vest against future work. The zenith lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the ember is where a second reviewer recomputes them. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
